# awscc_lakeformation_resource (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::LakeFormation::Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `hybrid_access_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the data access of tables pointing to the location can be managed by both Lake Formation permissions as well as Amazon S3 bucket policies.
- `resource_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Data Source.
- `resource_id` (String) The CloudFormation primary identifier for the LakeFormation::Resource. Mirrors ResourceArn once the resource exists; populated by the handler. Customers should reference the LakeFormation::Resource by ResourceArn.
- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role that registered a resource.
- `use_service_linked_role` (Boolean) Designates a trusted caller, an IAM principal, by registering this caller with the Data Catalog.
- `with_federation` (Boolean) Allows Lake Formation to assume a role to access tables in a federated database.
